title: fix(plugin-kanban): a kanban drawn in swimlanes shows the lane statistic the view settings offer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQVQdf3PvoJbKFFCUA4gwJB)_

Fixes #37326

## What changes

- **`KanbanImpl.tsx`, the swimlane layout.**
  - It now draws the view's lane statistic (`kanban.summary`) once per column, in a foot row (`data-kanban-swimlane-foot`) under every swimlane. The figure comes from the same `LaneFootStatistic` the flat board uses, read for the column's whole lane.
  - The foot row joins the board's one horizontal axis (`adoptSwimlaneScroll`, `data-swimlane-scroll-row`). It takes each cell's width from `laneBox`, so a figure sits under its column. A collapsed column draws an empty cell.
  - The column-title row writes `swimlaneColumnCount`. That is the whole-lane count from `laneCounts` where the host hands it (`wholeLaneCount`), else the cards drawn, marked over a windowed fetch as before.
  - Its `LaneTotal` now gets the `laneId`, so a header total reads the whole lane's figure where one exists.
  - A swimlane row's own count is marked `+` unless `swimlaneCountIsWhole` holds.
- **`ObjectKanban.tsx`.**
  - The one grouped lane read is asked on a swimlane board too, grouped by the lane field alone. The `flatLanes` gate moves off the question and off `hostLaneRead`.
  - The lanes past the page (`extraLaneIds`) stay flat-only.
- A new test file and a changeset (`@object-ui/plugin-kanban` patch).

## Why

The view settings offer count, sum, avg, min and max on every kanban. A board drawn in swimlanes rendered no lane foot, and it asked no lane read, so a picked statistic was blank there with no explanation.

The card's scope widening (7188972467) adds the rows-handed board: its swimlane column counts read the page, unmarked.

## Verification

- `ObjectKanban.swimlaneStatistic-37326.test.tsx` has 6 tests on a swimlane board, with `swimlaneField: 'region'` over 24 deals:
  - (a) A self-querying board draws `190` and `6` in one foot row, with no per-cell figure. It makes one read, `{ groupBy: ['stage'], aggregations: [sum] }`.
  - (b) A `count` statistic draws `20` and `4`.
  - (c) This is the #36871 rig: a page of 3 + 1 handed in with its query. The column counts read `20` and `4` from the read, the foot reads `190` and `6`, and the swimlane rows read `3+` and `1+`. The board reads nothing else.
  - (d) CONTROL: handed every record, every count is bare.
  - (e) The read is refused (403). The column and swimlane counts read the page marked `+`, and no figure is drawn.
  - (f) CONTROL: with no statistic, there is no foot row.
- **Ablation.** With `KanbanImpl.tsx` and `ObjectKanban.tsx` reverted to `main`, (a), (b), (c) and (e) fail, and the controls (d) and (f) pass.
- `vitest run` on `ui/packages/plugin-kanban`, plus `ListView.kanbanOwnsLanes-12619` and `app-shell` `listKanbanEveryRecord-12619`: 92 files, 633 passed.
- `tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-kanban/tsconfig.json` passes. `eslint` on the changed files reports 0 errors; the warnings are the files' existing `any`.
- `overlap-check` is clean against `origin/main`. #37667 shares both files and merges cleanly.

## Small decisions

- **The product fork the card leaves to the claimant: draw the statistic, do not hide the option.** The setting then works on every kanban it is offered on, and the picker is unchanged.
- **The shape is one figure per column, across every swimlane, at the board's foot.** It is the same figure the flat board draws for that lane. No cell (column × swimlane) draws its own figure, because the grouped read has no second grouping, and a per-cell figure would need one read per swimlane or a two-key group.
- The foot row is not sticky. It sits after the last swimlane, as a foot does. The title row's sticky pinning stays the only pinned row.
- A swimlane row's count is bare only when the board holds every record of its query. That means no windowed fetch and, on a rows-handed board, every lane the read counted drawn with all of its records. Otherwise it is a floor and is marked `+`.
- A swimlane board does not add the lanes that exist only past the page (`extraLaneIds`). Such a lane would be an empty column in every swimlane. The flat board keeps them.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
